question.title: Shipment label
question.question: Which characters are actually legible, and which information must remain unknown? Focus on the “Shipment label” screen.

request.systemPrompt:
You are the vision subsystem of a web-automation agent. A screenshot of the current browser viewport is attached. Describe what is on screen so the planning agent can decide its next action.

Format — keep it terse, structured, no flowery prose:

1) Page purpose: one line (e.g. "GitHub repo issue list", "Gmail compose", "Stripe checkout form").
2) Visible text: list the EXACT strings on buttons, links, headings, tabs, and menu items. Quote them verbatim. Do not paraphrase.
3) Inputs: list each visible form field with its label, placeholder, current value, and whether it is focused/disabled.
4) State signals: loading spinners, toasts, modals, error banners, success messages, CAPTCHAs, cookie/consent banners, overlays.
5) Blockers: anything that would prevent the next likely action (overlay, disabled submit, missing data, auth prompt).
6) Unknowns: if you cannot read something clearly, say so. Do not guess numbers, names, or identifiers.

Rules: no prose intro, no conclusion, no "this screenshot shows...", no layout description unless it matters (e.g. "left nav is collapsed"). If the page is blank or still loading, say that in one line and stop.
request.userText: Describe this screenshot of the current browser viewport for a web-automation agent. Follow the format in the system prompt.

response.content:
1) Page purpose: Document viewer showing a "Shipment label" record in the WebScene app.

2) Visible text:
- Top nav: "WebScene", "Home", "Workspace", "Activity"
- Eyebrow: "DOCUMENT VIEWER"
- Heading: "Shipment label"
- Row label: "Tracking code" — value: "ZX-81" (monospace)
- Yellow callout: "last 3 characters blurred" (italic, orange)
- Right sidebar: "Page 1 of 1", "125%"

3) Inputs: none visible — no form fields, buttons, or editable controls in the viewport.

4) State signals:
- Yellow/cream highlight box containing a blurred text value (redaction of a code/identifier, last 3 characters obscured per the note).
- Below the callout: 7 gray placeholder/skeleton bars (redacted or loading body text).
- No spinners, toasts, modals, errors, CAPTCHAs, or cookie banners.

5) Blockers:
- The blurred value is intentionally redacted; its content cannot be read and should not be guessed or inferred. Any task requiring that value is blocked unless an unblurring/reveal control exists (none visible).
- No interactive controls visible to zoom, page, or reveal content.

6) Unknowns:
- Blurred string content (unreadable by design).
- Whether the gray bars are loading placeholders or permanently redacted text.
- Whether the right sidebar has additional controls below the fold.
